verdict.rationale: Letta is itself an agent/agent-building platform (client role); the evidence only shows it consuming MCP servers as a client (SDK discovers/proxies MCP tools via mcpServers config) and exposing agents via ACP or OpenAI-compatible APIs, not via an official MCP server for other agents to connect to. Per the agent-role rule, this axis does not apply unless Letta itself runs as an MCP server, which is not evidenced.
